items.prompt_text: How many ways can you choose 3 items from a set of 7? Think step by step, then write ANSWER: followed by just the number.
items.output:
To find the number of ways to choose 3 items from a set of 7, we use the combination formula since the order of selection does not matter:

C(n, k) = n! / (k!(n - k)!)

Here, n = 7 and k = 3:
C(7, 3) = 7! / (3! × (7 - 3)!)
C(7, 3) = 7! / (3! × 4!)

Expand and simplify by canceling out the 4!:
C(7, 3) = (7 × 6 × 5 × 4!) / (3 × 2 × 1 × 4!)
C(7, 3) = (7 × 6 × 5) / (3 × 2 × 1)
C(7, 3) = 210 / 6
C(7, 3) = 35

ANSWER: 35

Principal (P) = $1000
Annual interest rate (r) = 10% = 0.10
Number of compounding periods per year (n) = 1 (compounded once per year)
